description: This file defines the 'AnyOf' composite validation rule class within the OrangeHRM system, extending an abstract composite class and specifying a rule class from the Respect Validation library.

classes.name: AnyOf
classes.description: A validation rule class that represents a composite 'any of' validation logic, inheriting from AbstractComposite and specifying the Respect Validation library's AnyOf rule.
